title: ipomoea bufalina
intro: Ipomoea bufalina, commonly known as Buffalo Horn or Wild Ipomoea, is a plant species native to Asia and Europe, belonging to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea bufalina include its ability to reduce fever, relieve cough, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
